name: Minnesota Open 2012
information: Registration is [here](http://www.cubingusa.com/minnesota/register.php). When you register, you can choose to pay your registration fees online or you can pay the day of the competition. Registration closes on June 19th at 11:59 PM. After that, you will be limited to only certain events (3x3, 2x2, Magics, and Pyraminx).
